title: Trump administration again denies entry visas to Palestinian officials ahead of UN general assembly
summary_or_snippet: For the second year in a row, the administration has barred the Palestinian delegation from US travel for the forum The US state department said on Wednesday that it had again denied entry visas to Palestinian officials ahead next week's United Nations general assembly gathering in New York .
